gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.
Past perfect for the earlier of two past moments.

gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: She's very good ___ explaining difficult ideas.
We ran out ___ petrol on the motorway.
gaps.explanation: 'run out OF something' = have none left.

gaps.sentence: We went out ___ it was raining heavily.
He ___ his keys on the bus this morning.
gaps.explanation: 'leave something somewhere' = forget to take it: left his keys on the bus.
